spec.description:
Autex Mirage Cube is an intricately textured acoustic panel range designed to
add tactile depth and acoustic comfort to interior walls and ceilings. Etched
directly into semi-rigid Cube polyester felt using a precision manufacturing
process, Mirage features six refined micro-pattern designs—Bouclé, Brutalist,
Offset, Rammed Earth, Lapis, and Mortar. Available in 12mm and 24mm thicknesses
across standard 2400mm x 1200mm and 2700mm x 1200mm panels, it provides sound
absorption ratings from NRC 0.45 to 0.80 and Group 1 fire compliance.

install:
Ensure wall or ceiling substrate is flat, clean, dry, and
dust-free

Acclimatise panels in the installation environment for at least 24
hours prior to fitting

Inspect panel pattern direction and ensure consistent
grain alignment across walls

For adhesive fix, apply recommended high-grab MS
polymer or contact adhesive evenly to the panel back

Alternatively, mount
using SpinFix clips or Peel and Stick backing where specified

Butt bevelled
edges neatly together and apply firm, even pressure with a roller across the
entire face

Trim perimeter panels carefully from the face using a straight
edge and sharp utility knife

limitations:
Indoor use only; avoid direct water exposure or extreme
humidity

Pattern has a directional grain; panels must be installed in uniform
orientation
Batch-to-batch variations may occur due to fibre blending

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Mirage Cube is an intricately textured acoustic panel
range featuring micro-patterned textures—Bouclé, Brutalist, Offset, Rammed
Earth, Lapis, and Mortar—etched into 12mm or 24mm semi-rigid Cube polyester
felt. Sized in 2400mm x 1200mm and 2700mm x 1200mm sheets with standard 4mm
bevelled edges, it delivers sound absorption ratings from NRC 0.45 to 0.80.
Rated Group 1 fire compliant under AS ISO 9705 and containing at least 80%
recycled PET, it provides a tactile, carbon-neutral alternative to plain
acoustic felt for walls and ceilings.
